pairs.question: Convenire autem utrum inter privatos sufficit an vero etiam ipsius praetoris consensus necessarius est?
pairs.derivation: Genuine direct interrogative (utrum ... an vero) posed and answered by the jurist. The answer skips the non-answering preamble that merely grounds the rule in the lex Iulia ('lex iulia iudiciorum ait "quo minus inter privatos conveniat":') and advances to the operative answering sentence 'sufficit ergo privatorum consensus'. Stops at the first full stop; what follows ('proinde si privati consentiant ... eius esse iurisdictionem') is further elaboration on a different scenario.

pairs.question: Mater decedens extraneum ex dodrante heredem instituit, filiam unam ex quadrante, alteram praeteriit: haec de inofficioso egit et optinuit. Scriptae filiae quomodo succurrendum sit?
pairs.answer: Filia praeterita id vindicare debet, quod intestata matre habitura esset.
pairs.derivation: Real interrogative (quomodo). The declarative setup ('Mater decedens ... egit et optinuit') is kept verbatim before the question so the referent 'scriptae filiae' is intelligible. The framing 'quaero,' is dropped as narration of the asking; first word capitalized. Answer drops the framing 'respondi:' and takes the operative first sentence to the first full stop; what follows ('itaque dici potest ...') is digressive elaboration.

pairs.question: Lucius titius cum in falsi testamenti propinqui accusatione non optinuerit, an de non iure facto nec signato testamento querella illi competere possit?
pairs.answer: Non ideo repelli ab intentione non iure facti testamenti, quod in falsi accusatione non optinuerit.
pairs.derivation: Real interrogative (an ... possit). The verbatim case setup ('Lucius titius cum ... non optinuerit') is kept so the question has context; the framing 'quaero,' is dropped as narration of the asking. Answer drops the framing 'respondit'; first word capitalized. It directly answers the question (the querella is not barred). This is the entire response.
